utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, sorry I'm late — just making sure, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, I think you might have it mixed up—it's actually this Saturday at the community center, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, I could've sworn I heard it was moved to Sunday. Let me double-check with Rosa — she's the one who told me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, just a heads-up—the repair drive got moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday? I can still make it—just need to adjust my plans. The hammer and nails will be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I've already updated my calendar. I'll bring the toolbox and be at the community center by 9 AM Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So is it for household items or the fence? I need to know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure, but I'm hoping they can fix my bike chain.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You're bringing a bike chain? I thought this was about fixing the fence. Did they change the plan?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Noah, the toaster — tools are by my door if you need extras.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the toaster. But didn't we move it to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, it's still Saturday at the garden fence. I've got the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, have you heard about that repair drive at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I heard! It's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center—not Saturday at the front porch like before. Are you planning to bring something?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I didn't realize it moved to Sunday! I was planning to bring my old toaster for fixing, but I'll see you there then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, Saturday at 9, school parking lot. I'll try to dig up some old tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I'll bring my toolbox as well.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, the more the merrier. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, from what Hana said, it's both bikes and appliances—people bring stuff to the community center, and they have a parts swap. I think it's pretty organized, but I'd check with her.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I remember seeing a flyer about it somewhere too. Good to know it's organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I think I saw that flyer too—maybe I should write myself a note so I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Faye! I'll mark you down for the morning shift—thanks for pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh wait, Mara—I thought the repair drive was moved to Sunday at the community center. Did I get that wrong?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, it's still this Saturday from 9 to 4 at the garden—no changes. Sorry for the mix-up!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, do you know the exact drop-off times? I'm worried we'll miss it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Pia! Don't you worry — it's now Sunday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at the community center, so you'll have plenty of time to bring things by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. That's a relief.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, you know about the repair drive at the community center? I heard they're collecting old bikes and appliances to fix up—maybe we could rally some friends to help out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I know all about it—it's actually happening this Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday. I'll be there with my tools, and I'd love to get some friends involved!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great you're bringing tools! What if I round up some folks from the book club to swing by?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I prefer things to stay on schedule, but at least we have a clear plan now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Who organized that? I didn't see any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it was posted on the neighborhood board yesterday, but I suppose it's easy to miss with all the clutter. I've got the details right here if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? We're fixing up the garden shed and could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was for old bikes and appliances—is the fence part of that, or are we switching focus?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's actually both! The main event is fixing up the garden shed, but people are also bringing small appliances and bikes to repair.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Sam, just to double-check, is the repair drive still focused on bikes and appliances, or did it expand to include other items?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Far as I know, it's still just bikes and small appliances. They didn't mention anything else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, thanks for confirming. I'll make sure to spread the word that it's still just bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Faye, is the repair drive for the garden fence or for household items? I'm a bit confused.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not entirely sure about the specifics—I just know it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, it's been moved? I didn't hear about that. Are you sure it's not still happening at the garden?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the drive should be able to sort your chain out. I'll be there helping, so just bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, what repair drive was that again? I keep hearing about it but I'm not sure what it is.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's this Saturday at the community garden. We're fixing up the shed and helping with small repairs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Oren, it's a general repair drive—bikes, chairs, small appliances, you name it. Rosa's got me managing the tool sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, both! Great, that clears things up. I'll dig out that wobbly chair I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, bring it by! We'll have all the tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules! You're gonna love this—we're rallying everyone for a repair drive this Saturday morning. The garden shed needs some love, and we could use your handy skills!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds awesome, Quinn! I'm always up for a repair project—count me in for Saturday. Is the garden shed part of the bigger repair drive at the community center, or is this a separate thing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's all one big push this Saturday! We're hitting the garden shed, then moving to Mrs. Henderson's fence—it's gonna be a full morning of teamwork.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane, did you hear the repair drive got moved? It's now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard that too. Glad I caught up, I thought it was still Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster—hope they can fix it! You got anything you're planning to bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it's Saturday morning at the community center, but I'm not sure about the exact time. Did anyone see a flyer?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, the flyer says drop-off is from 9 to 11 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that gives us a window. Should we coordinate who's bringing what so we're not hauling things back and forth?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Quinn, I just heard the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday? That's good to know. I was wondering about the time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It starts at 10 AM, I believe—double-check the flyer if you want, but that's what I've got down.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, you heard anything more about that repair drive? I'm still hoping they can sort out my busted bike chain.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm bringing my toolbox and some spare nails. You're coming on Saturday for the repair drive at the garden fence, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's at the garden fence this Saturday? That's perfect, I'll definitely bring my bike along and hope they can fix that chain.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! Great to see you. I wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, Sunday? That's a change from Saturday. Well, I'll adjust my schedule. Thanks for letting me know, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No problem, Eli! I'm glad you can make it. We'll have the tool sign-ups ready at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You know, I think it's to fix up old appliances and electronics for folks who can't afford repairs. Heard they're collecting stuff this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: This weekend? Are you sure? I haven't seen a single notice anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I could've sworn I heard it at the grocery store, but maybe I got the dates mixed up.
